upload.title: Upload a quiz
upload.intro: Upload a YAML or JSON question bank, or paste one below.
upload.textPlaceholder: Paste your YAML or JSON quiz here
upload.formatSummary: What does a quiz file look like?
upload.formatIntro: A complete, valid quiz. Copy it and replace the content.
upload.formatExample:
version: 1
title: Road signs
language: en
run:
  questionsPerRun: 2
  maxErrors: 1
questions:
  - type: single
    prompt: What does a red triangular sign mean?
    explanation: Triangular signs warn of danger ahead.
    options:
      - text: Warning
        correct: true
      - text: Prohibition
        correct: false
  - type: boolean
    prompt: You may park on a pedestrian crossing.
    answer: false
  - type: multi
    prompt: Which are mandatory when overtaking?
    options:
      - text: Check the road is clear
        correct: true
      - text: Signal your intention
        correct: true
      - text: Sound the horn
        correct: false
upload.formatRulesTitle: The rules that catch people out
upload.formatRuleOptions: A single or multi question needs between 2 and 10 options.
upload.formatRuleSingle: A single question has exactly one option with correct: true; a multi question has at least one.
upload.formatRuleBoolean: A true/false question carries answer: true or answer: false, and no options.
upload.formatRulePerRun: questionsPerRun cannot be larger than the number of questions, and maxErrors cannot be larger than questionsPerRun.
upload.fileCleared: Your browser cleared the chosen file when the upload came back. Choose it again, or paste its contents below.

errors.unauthorized: You must be signed in to upload a quiz.
errors.tooLarge: The file is larger than 1 MB.
errors.empty: Choose a file or paste a quiz first.
errors.rateLimited: You have uploaded a lot of quizzes recently. Try again later.

notFound.title: That link leads nowhere
notFound.body: Nothing lives at this address. A challenge link dies with the run behind it, so one that was never finished leads here, and so does a quiz its author has removed. A mistyped address does the same.

errorPage.title: This page did not load
errorPage.body: Something broke on our side, not yours. Nothing you had already finished is lost. Trying again often works.
